Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct ONLY arms and held-object intermediate position in image1. Image1 is the prior NE04 edit and its sword arm still reaches too far BACKWARD; this is the single defect to fix. Images2 and3 are preceding NE03 and following NE05; image4 is the approved style. One transparent square RGBA sprite native1254x1254 preferred.
Move the anatomical RIGHT sword grip SIGNIFICANTLY TOWARD THE BODY'S WAIST, not left behind the character: place its hand around 56% of full canvas width and 63% of full canvas height. The visible right shoulder stays exactly at its present location; let the upper arm angle DOWN BESIDE THE TORSO, the elbow bend naturally near the waist, and the forearm end at that halfway grip position. The hand must be midway between image2's forward sword grip and image3's rear sword grip. Do not retain the old outstretched backward sleeve/hand. The sword blade is now lowered ALMOST VERTICALLY DOWN, tip around 56% width and 96% height, passing in front of the open space between the legs with correct occlusion; do not change any leg to make room. This is a passing pose, not the full backward sword endpoint. Preserve blade length, exact design, right-handed grip and one connected shoulder-sleeve-elbow-wrist chain.
The anatomical LEFT talisman hand should be almost at the far waist, halfway from its rear image2 position to forward image3. Allow its forearm/blue rectangular talisman to be mostly naturally hidden by torso/hair; only a short part need be visible. Do not put it at full forward extension. No third hand.
Keep everything else exactly as image1: entire head/hair/face, torso position, body silhouette except sleeves, bluewhitegold rendering, hips, thighs, knees, shins, ankles and BOTH BOOTS in the SAME positions, shape and angle. LEFT support foot remains planted, RIGHT leg remains bent/airborne. Hip-thigh-knee-shin-ankle-toe chains keep the same NE travel plane, no toes outward, no splay, no leg/pelvis turn or scale change. Preserve normal sole visibility. No full-character shift, no rescaling, no cropping, no mirroring, background, shadow, text, extra limbs/objects. True transparent alpha.
